title: Kuwait - Cabinet approves draft amendments to the Public Tenders Law (Law No. 49 of 2016)
summary: On 9 Sept 2026 the Cabinet approved a draft decree-law amending Law 49/2016 that would prohibit local and commission agents in government contracting; it is not in force until Gazette publication. Revisit any agent-led bid structure for CAPT and KPC-family tenders now and track the Gazette.
citedText: A prohibition on the use of a local agent or a commission-based agent

title: Analysis: AI could unlock $230 billion in annual upstream oil and gas value
summary: McKinsey sizes upstream AI value at ~$65bn near-term and ~$230bn at full potential, concentrated in production optimisation, drilling and reservoir management; fewer than 20% of deployments track and share value KPIs. Use it to anchor a value hypothesis with a baseline and shared KPI, and to argue for performance-linked commercial models.

title: Local Content and Industrial Resilience in Middle East Energy Projects
summary: Covers ADNOC's Industrial Resilience Program with Local+ and ICV+ credit for local manufacturing, and Aramco's 75% in-Kingdom procurement target; a localisation commitment binds only if the contract says so. Check ICV/IKTVA positioning and contract wording before the next Gulf NOC bid.
citedText: Local content requirements have been a feature of procurement in the Middle East energy sector for many years.
